posts.author: userkanra
posts.body:
I wanted to get my first post out of the way, so here is my introduction ^-^
I've always been curious about creating an RPG Maker game, and recently decided that I really want to give it a shot. These forums seem like a great resource, so I decided to join and hopefully figure out what I'm doing. I've always enjoyed forum environments as well!
I'm a complete beginner when it comes to this sort of thing, but I'm eager to learn. If anyone has some super beginner tips for a newbie, that would be appreciated as well!
Thanks and nice to meet you
​

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
Beginner tips: do the tutorials (in MZ's Help menu), the documentation describes every box on every screen (also in the Help menu), and make some little practice games to learn with.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum and to RPG Maker!
In addition to what was suggested above, I always recommend searching YouTube for something like RPG Maker MZ Tutorials. You can find some content creators who have entire tutorial series from basics to more advanced concepts.
I recommend just picking on and going through them all. But instead of just watching, recreate them in a test project. By the time you are finished, you should have a pretty good understanding of the essential concepts. Then you can be more targeted with the tutorials that you use to learn more.
Then it is just experimenting and practicing, learning to make things that interest you before starting on a small project to get the experience of the end to end concepts.
Good luck and just remember to enjoy what you do!
